findings.title: Commit markers are formatted as checklist items
findings.description: The commit instructions use `- [ ] Commit: ...` rather than plain `**Commit**:` lines. This is repeated throughout the task file; reformat the markers while keeping them at the tested checkpoints.

findings.title: The duplication-limit test does not verify other metrics remain unaffected
findings.description: Task 11 tests the token ceiling at the generic duplication-measurement level, but does not verify Success Criterion 10’s requirement that exceeding the ceiling leaves the adapter’s other metrics unchanged. Add an adapter-level test for that outcome.

findings.title: A malformed line number has no corresponding reader test
findings.description: Task 19 requires a failure for a non-integer `<line number>`, but Task 20 tests `hits="x"` and does not cover a malformed `number`. Add a test asserting the failure and its diagnostic, as required by the failure-mode testing requirement.

findings.title: No load test covers the stated duplication scaling bound
findings.description: The design states that duplication’s time and memory are linear in tokens and sets a four-million-token ceiling. The task breakdown tests the ceiling with a lowered constant, but has no load test in `tests/load/` covering that stated bound. Add a load-test task and an explicit CI task to gate on it.

structured_findings.summary: Commit markers are formatted as checklist items
